# FlinT OS — application component (firmware logic for FlinT devices)

get_filename_component(FLINT_COMPONENT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}" ABSOLUTE)

# board_build.cmake is generated by tools/gen_board_catalog.py (root CMakeLists).
include("${FLINT_COMPONENT_DIR}/board/board_build.cmake")
if(DEFINED IDF_TARGET AND NOT "${FLINT_BOARD_IDF_TARGET}" STREQUAL "${IDF_TARGET}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "FLINT_BOARD '${FLINT_BOARD_ID}' expects idf_target=${FLINT_BOARD_IDF_TARGET}, "
        "but IDF_TARGET=${IDF_TARGET}. Run: idf.py set-target ${FLINT_BOARD_IDF_TARGET}")
endif()
message(STATUS "FlinT OS board ${FLINT_BOARD_ID} (${FLINT_BOARD_DISPLAY_ID}, bus=${FLINT_BOARD_DISPLAY_BUS})")

set(FLINT_SRC_DIRS
    anim
    app
    assets
    display
    display/fonts
    day_mode
    event
    faces
    i18n
    net
    settings
    shell
    time
    ui
)

idf_component_register(
    SRC_DIRS ${FLINT_SRC_DIRS}
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        "."
    REQUIRES
        nvs_flash
        esp_event
        esp_netif
        esp_wifi
        esp_timer
        freertos
        lwip
        heap
        log
        esp_driver_usb_serial_jtag
        LovyanGFX
        joltwallet__littlefs
)
